title: Read a receipt
prompt:
Read the attached image and answer in exactly these lines, one per line, nothing else:

store: <name>
date: <YYYY-MM-DD>
items: <how many line items were bought>
priciest: <the most expensive item>
total: <amount paid>
tip: <tip amount>

If the image does not show something, write `not shown` for it. Do not guess.

must_find.regex: (?m)^[^\w\n]*tip[^\w\n]*:[ \t*_`\"']*(not shown|not visible|not present|not listed|not given|not stated|not on the|not in the|not provided|not included|none shown|n/?a\b|none\b|no such|does not show|doesn't show|cannot be (?:determined|answered|seen)|can't be (?:determined|answered|seen)|unanswerable)
must_find.label: tip: not shown

must_not_claim.label: tip: a value (the receipt shows none)

why: Printed text, a date written differently from how it is asked for, a count and a maximum.
